title: Fix the per-request CSP builder
acceptanceCriteria: `script-src` allows inline script only through `'nonce-…'` with this response's nonce, and contains no `'unsafe-inline'`
Two calls to `cspForRequest` return two different nonces
The policy has `object-src 'none'` and an explicit `base-uri` (`'none'` or `'self'`)
The configured script and connect origins, `frame-ancestors 'none'` and `report-to` are still there
Nonces are base64 and carry at least 128 bits
